text: 民政部、国家发展改革委、工业和信息化部、商务部、市场监管总局、全国老龄办印发《关于培育多元场景 促进适老用品产品消费的若干措施》。措施提出，推动智慧适老用品产品应用。以国家重大科技项目为牵引，加快推进具身智能、大语言模型、脑机接口、外骨骼等前沿技术在养老领域应用，研发升级老年人失能照护、康复护理、精神陪护等智能设备。
text_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Commerce, the State Administration for Market Regulation and the National Office on Aging issued Several Measures on Cultivating Diverse Scenarios to Promote Consumption of Age-Friendly Products. The measures propose promoting the application of smart age-friendly products. Driven by major national science and technology projects, accelerate the application of frontier technologies such as embodied intelligence, large language models, brain-computer interfaces and exoskeletons in elderly care, and develop and upgrade smart devices for care of disabled elderly, rehabilitation nursing and companionship.
